# Pie raises $23.7M to bring AI-powered growth to Main Street businesses

Led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Pie’s $19.5M Series A brings total funding to $23.7M and will help the company scale its platform partnerships and AI product suite across growth, local discovery and customer conversion.

Published by, Pie, on, Jun 30, 2026

NEW YORK, NY, June 30, 2026 – Pie, the AI-powered growth platform for small businesses, today announced a $19.5 million Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, bringing its total funding to $23.7 million. The round included participation from Capital One Ventures, Max Levchin’s SciFi VC, F-Prime, Commerce Ventures, WEX Venture Capital, and existing investors. The company also announced its emergence from stealth and launched Front Desk, an AI product that answers calls for small business owners 24/7, takes bookings and reservations, and responds to customer questions.

Founded by former Square and Toast operators Syed Ali and Akhil Mantripragada, Pie is building the growth infrastructure layer for Main Street businesses at a time when customer discovery is shifting across AI search, Google and digital channels. Ali and Mantripragada spent the last 15 years collectively building products for small businesses, where they heard the same pain point again and again: owners did not need another tool. They needed more customers.

Pie was built to solve that problem directly, helping small businesses get found, capture demand and convert customer intent into revenue.

Since launching its first AI-powered growth product in late 2025, Pie has grown to reach thousands of small business customers while in stealth, largely through referrals and platform partnerships, and expanded its product suite across AI Search, Growth, and Front Desk.

Small businesses represent one of the largest and most underserved software markets, but most local merchants have historically been priced out of enterprise-grade growth tools or forced to rely on agencies that can charge $2,500 to $5,000 per month, require long-term contracts and offer limited transparency. Many existing tools focus on managing current customers, while Pie is focused on helping businesses generate net-new demand from sources like ChatGPT, Claude, Google Maps, Meta & Yelp. Pie gives SMBs access to an always-on growth platform that can optimize profiles, create content to improve local discovery across different channels and capture customer demand at a fraction of traditional agency costs, without requiring owners to manage multiple tools or channels themselves.

# Pie Announces Investment from Amex Ventures to Help Expand AI-Powered Growth Platform for Small Businesses 

 Provided by Business Wire Aug 4, 2026, 2:00:00 PM

 Pie Announces Investment from Amex Ventures to Help Expand AI-Powered Growth Platform for Small Businesses 

 Investment will help accelerate Pie’s next phase of growth, supporting the expansion of its platform partnerships, product suite and team 

 Pie, the AI-powered growth platform for small businesses, today announced an investment from Amex Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of American Express. The investment follows Pie’s emergence from stealth in June, and the announcement of its $19.5 million Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Max Levchin’s SciFi VC, F-Prime, Commerce Ventures, WEX Venture Capital and existing investors. 

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804437204/en/

 

 As customer discovery continues to evolve across digital and AI-powered experiences, many small business owners don't have the time, budget, or expertise to manage their presence across an increasingly complex landscape. Many also rely on marketing solutions that make it difficult to understand which activities are driving meaningful business results. Pie was built to help businesses get discovered, capture demand, and connect customer engagement to measurable business outcomes. 

 Through three core offerings, AI Search helps businesses improve their visibility as local discovery shifts to AI-powered search experiences like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity; Growth helps businesses acquire customers across high-intent local channels like Google Maps, Yelp and Nextdoor; and Front Desk uses a voice agent to answer calls, take bookings and respond to customer questions. 

 “After years of building products for small businesses and hearing directly from owners, one need consistently stood out: they wanted more customers, not another tool to manage,” said Syed Ali, CEO and Co-Founder of Pie. “We built Pie for how small businesses actually operate, meeting them where they are and taking a revenue-first approach to growth. The investment from Amex Ventures will help us accelerate that mission and reach more of the businesses that power local economies across the country.” 

 “We are constantly on the lookout for innovations that deliver differentiated value to small businesses,” said Margaret Lim, Managing Director of Amex Ventures. “Pie is doing just that – helping small businesses find new customers by combining a growing suite of sophisticated AI-powered customer acquisition capabilities with a delightful easy-to-use experience. Syed and Akhil know this market need deeply and we are excited to be backing them.”

# American Express just invested in Pie through Amex Ventures. | Pie · LinkedIn · 2026-08-04

**Pie**: Pie has 1-10 employees. Headquartered in Houston, United States, with an office in Boston.

---

[American Express](https://linkedin.com/company/american-express) just invested in Pie through Amex Ventures.

Growing a business is stressful enough.

We've always believed it shouldn't feel like a grind, and it means something when a company that's spent over a decade backing small businesses through Shop Small looks at what we're building and decides to back it too.

That's on top of the $19.5M Series A we closed in June, led by [Lightspeed](https://linkedin.com/company/lightspeed-venture-partners) Venture Partners, with [Capital One](https://linkedin.com/company/capital-one) Ventures and [WEX](https://linkedin.com/company/wexinc) (total funding: $23.7M), when we came out of stealth.

We're already seeing the mission play out: partners like [MoeGo](https://linkedin.com/company/moego) are using Pie inside software they already run and seeing an average 15x return on ad spend. That momentum spans auto repair, fitness, and beauty too, with more than 100,000 calls driven to local businesses and many owners seeing 15 to 20 percent year-over-year growth.

Same mission as day one: helping local businesses grow, and having some fun while we do it. We're excited to keep building that with Amex by our side.

Read the full announcement: link in comments below!

We've been quietly building Pie for the last several months, and today we have some news! We're officially out of stealth, and we just closed a $19.5M Series A led by Lightspeed, bringing total funding to $23.7M, with participation from Capital One Ventures, SciFi VC, F-Prime, Commerce Ventures, WEX Venture Capital, Restive Ventures, Cambrian and our existing investors. We bring 3 agents to market for the local businesses: – Growth: takes all of the POS & CRM data and creates content to find local customers across multiple platforms like Google Maps, Meta, Yelp, & Nextdoor, always learning and optimizing for the best performance. – AI Search: takes those profiles and optimizes them for local LLM search (asking ChatGPT or Gemini where to take your car in for repair, or which hair salon in your area you should visit for a new look). – Front Desk: we have all the context needed to give that specific business a voice agent for answering calls, taking bookings, responding to customer questions, and ensuring it never misses a sale. We’re proud to have steered over 100,000+ calls to local businesses in the last 10 months. Thousands of small business owners already trust Pie, mostly through referrals. Across the platform, we’ve driven more than 100,000 phone calls to small businesses, and customers typically see a 15 to 20% increase in year-over-year sales.
